Automate compliance validation, streamline approval workflows, and gain real-time financial insights.
        Built for enterprises that demand precision and transparency.
Choose the right FinStack workspace for your responsibilities and sign in from one shared entry point.
Employees can submit claims, track approvals, and manage reimbursement activity.
Team leads can review requests, approve budgets, and monitor their reporting structure.
Finance teams can reconcile payments, monitor transactions, and manage controls.
Compliance staff can audit activity, enforce policies, and review risk signals.
Full system control across all platform modules, roles, and organization-wide environment setup.
Submit your organization for review. Workspace access begins after Admin approval.
Learn how your Configuration Manager can securely provision your employee account.
Comprehensive tools to manage, track, and optimize your organization's expenses
Review expenses against configured policies and route exceptions for compliance review.
Move expenses through structured manager, compliance, and finance review stages.
Use dashboard and reporting views to monitor expense activity and financial operations.
Role-specific workspaces keep expense actions aligned with each user's responsibilities.
Track key expense workflow decisions, reviews, and operational activity.
Process payment activity through the Bank Sandbox and reconcile related transactions.
A clear workflow from expense submission to reconciled payment.
Employees submit an expense and attach the supporting receipt.
Managers review the request and approve or reject it in the workflow.
Policy and compliance checks are completed when the workflow requires them.
Finance validates approved expenses and prepares the payment step.
Payments are processed through the Bank Sandbox and reconciled before the expense is paid.
Choose an active FinStack plan and see its included seats, features, and optional add-ons.
Your recurring subscription is based on the selected plan, employee count, and optional paid add-ons.
Need help with onboarding, billing, or using FinStack?

Register a prospective organization for review, or sign in to an existing account. For access and support options, read our contact guidance; public enquiries and ticket submission are not configured.
